scope: All 67 initial neutral-theme Darwin canonical PNGs visually inspected. This approves baseline content; it is not an ordinary screenshot comparison result.

runtime.javascriptDependencies: npm-installed from the public registry into a temporary consumer; Arras and theme installed from exact cohort tarballs

review_method: Inspected all 67 in 17 labeled contact sheets; separately inspected 18 original images covering dense dialogs, long hub/product/result/type lists, and narrow solution pages. Original tall hub images tool-rendered at 1120x2048; text and layout remained legible.
qualifications: Magenta masks intentionally cover attribution/freshness and entire gb-history panel, as defined in canonical visual.spec.ts; those pixels are outside visual content approval.
Narrow dialog attribution masks can overlay parts of buttons because Playwright masks underlying locators; unmasked new-form/retire and semantic UI tests provide separate evidence.
Ordinary full 272 run with snapshots disabled remains required.

files.notes: Expected canonical volatile-content masks retained; no unexpected clipping, overlap, missing branding, or light/dark palette defect observed.
